dedupe_keys.name: ihydroslide3d figure data and plotting code

description: This collection provides figure data and Python plotting code for the iHydroSlide3D hydrology and landslide study by Guoding Chen and collaborators. The repository separates material by figure, including discharge spreadsheets, soil-moisture and slope-stability rasters, failure-probability maps, landslide area and volume, and ROC evaluation tables. It supports checking the published Yuehe River application and adapting the evaluation workflow for infrastructure hazard models. Filenames identify July 2012 snapshots, and the discharge plotting script uses hourly rainfall and simulated versus observed flow. The files are listed as GeoTIFF, XLSX and Python, with a separate Zenodo ZIP archive. Access is free; Zenodo labels the licence other-open, but does not identify specific terms, and GitHub has no licence declaration. Raster resolution and complete temporal coverage remain unverified because payloads were not downloaded. The plotting script contains fixed paths and plotting assumptions. No directly related catalogue dataset was found, and published performance annotations were not treated as independently reproduced results.
